verdict.rationale: DeepInfra is an AI inference cloud, and a built-in assistant in its console or docs is a plausible capability, so this axis applies. The evidence only documents OpenAI-compatible inference APIs, model hosting and GPU rental. Those are developer building blocks for making your own assistant, not an in-product assistant that users can hand tasks to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
